<p>Generate a retail (4-4-5, 4-5-4, or 5-4-4) calendar mapping table
</p>

## Usage

```r
generate_retail_calendar(
  start_date,
  end_date,
  calendar_type,
  fiscal_year_start = 1,
  week_start = 7
)
```

## Arguments

<dl class="qrtdown-arguments">
<dt id="arg-start-date"><code>start_date</code><a class="anchor" aria-label="anchor" href="#arg-start-date"></a></dt>
<dd><p>Start date (Date or character YYYY-MM-DD)</p></dd>
<dt id="arg-end-date"><code>end_date</code><a class="anchor" aria-label="anchor" href="#arg-end-date"></a></dt>
<dd><p>End date (Date or character YYYY-MM-DD)</p></dd>
<dt id="arg-calendar-type"><code>calendar_type</code><a class="anchor" aria-label="anchor" href="#arg-calendar-type"></a></dt>
<dd><p>One of "445", "454", "544"</p></dd>
<dt id="arg-fiscal-year-start"><code>fiscal_year_start</code><a class="anchor" aria-label="anchor" href="#arg-fiscal-year-start"></a></dt>
<dd><p>Integer 1-12, month the fiscal year starts nearest to</p></dd>
<dt id="arg-week-start"><code>week_start</code><a class="anchor" aria-label="anchor" href="#arg-week-start"></a></dt>
<dd><p>Integer 1-7, day of week (1=Monday, 7=Sunday)</p></dd>
</dl>

## Value

<p>A tibble with columns: date, year, quarter, month, week
</p>
